Row.Text: Twelve cities between two rivers, rich on iron and bronze, famous for their engineers, their diviners and their banquets.
Rasna, the people of the Twelve
Build a Cuniculus and a Tumulus in the same District to form the Spura, which pays every Settlement you own. Everything you build goes up faster than your neighbours' work.
Lars Porsenna of Clusium, who marched on Rome and, they say, built a tomb with a labyrinth beneath it.
